journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

articles.title_en: Noise and Learning: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 噪声与学习：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: Despite high noise pollution, empirical research on the impact of noise on learning in developing economies has been sparse. We investigate this question by analyzing spatial and temporal variation in noise pollution recorded by monitoring stations in India and academic performance in high-stakes Class 12 examinations across schools. We find that a 10-percentage-point increase in noisy days during the exam quarter is associated with a 2.3% increase in the failure rate of Class 12 boys. This pattern is not gender neutral, as no association between noise pollution and failure rate is observed for girls. We do not find any effect of noise pollution recorded during non-exam months. By documenting how noise pollution hinders learning in India and shedding light on cognitive burden explanation, our study highlights an overlooked threat to human capital accumulation in developing economies and underscores the importance of integrating noise pollution mitigation strategies into education and urban policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管噪声污染严重，但关于噪声对发展中经济体学习影响的实证研究一直较为稀少。我们通过分析印度监测站记录的噪声污染在空间和时间上的变化，以及各学校高利害关系Class 12考试中的学业表现，来研究这一问题。我们发现，考试季度内噪声天数增加10个百分点，与Class 12男生失败率上升2.3%相关。这一模式并非性别中性，因为未观察到噪声污染与女生失败率之间的关联。我们未发现非考试月份记录的噪声污染有任何影响。通过记录噪声污染如何阻碍印度的学习，并揭示认知负担解释，我们的研究凸显了发展中经济体人力资本积累中一个被忽视的威胁，并强调了将噪声污染缓解策略纳入教育和城市政策的重要性。

articles.title_en: Increasing Household Waste Segregation Rates in the Presence of a Segregated Collection Service: A Randomized Controlled Trial in India
articles.title_cn: 在存在分类收集服务的情况下提高家庭垃圾分类率：印度的一项随机对照试验
articles.abstract_en: Proper waste management is an increasingly important challenge in developing countries, and waste segregation at source is a critical step toward greater efficiency and smaller environmental impacts. This study presents the results of a field experiment in India, examining whether and how a household campaign can change households’ waste segregation behavior in the presence of a reliable segregated collection service. The campaign has two variants: (1) a one-shot household campaign providing an information brochure and a bucket and (2) the same one-shot campaign enhanced by weekly reminders. We find that, with a reliable collection service in place, a household campaign providing information brochures and buckets increases the waste segregation rate by 45 percentage points, and the “campaign plus reminders” treatment increases the segregation rate by 60 percentage points. We show that a low-cost, soft-touch household campaign can quickly and significantly increase waste segregation when a reliable segregated collection service exists.
articles.abstract_cn: 适当的废物管理是发展中国家日益重要的挑战，而源头垃圾分类是提高效率和减少环境影响的关键一步。本研究呈现了印度一项实地实验的结果，考察在存在可靠的分类收集服务的情况下，家庭宣传活动能否以及如何改变家庭的垃圾分类行为。该宣传活动有两种变体：（1）一次性家庭宣传活动，提供信息手册和一个桶；（2）相同的一次性宣传活动，但增加了每周提醒。我们发现，在存在可靠收集服务的情况下，提供信息手册和桶的家庭宣传活动使垃圾分类率提高了45个百分点，而“宣传加提醒”处理使分类率提高了60个百分点。我们表明，当存在可靠的分类收集服务时，低成本、温和的家庭宣传活动能够快速且显著地提高垃圾分类率。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Offshoring and Import Competition on Carbon Emissions
articles.title_cn: 离岸外包与进口竞争对碳排放的影响
articles.abstract_en: We use Danish firm-level data to jointly examine the causal effects of offshoring and Chinese import competition on carbon emissions, output, and the emission intensity of output. Offshoring reduces firms’ emission intensity but also increases their production such that firm-level emissions do not change. Chinese import competition reduces firms’ production and their emission intensity. Next, we apply our firm-level estimates in counterfactual decompositions and in the computation of emission-leakage rates. The resulting evidence shows that offshoring leads to cleaner production in the manufacturing sector while import competition from China mostly leads to more emissions abroad.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用丹麦企业层面数据，联合考察离岸外包和中国进口竞争对碳排放、产出和产出排放强度的因果效应。离岸外包降低了企业的排放强度，但也增加了其生产，因此企业层面排放没有变化。中国进口竞争降低了企业的生产及其排放强度。接下来，我们将企业层面估计应用于反事实分解和排放泄漏率的计算。由此得到的证据表明，离岸外包导致制造业部门的生产更清洁，而来自中国的进口竞争主要导致国外排放增加。

articles.title_en: Energy Efficiency Dynamics and Climate Policy
articles.title_cn: 能源效率动态与气候政策
articles.abstract_en: We study the effectiveness of climate change mitigation policies in reducing carbon emissions, focusing on the channel of economy-wide energy efficiency. Using US data, we estimate an impulse response function (IRF) that characterizes how energy efficiency responds to energy price shocks. Standard climate-economy models cannot replicate the slow transition dynamics observed in the data. We build a tractable model that nests the existing literature and can closely replicate the empirical IRF. The slow dynamics in our model imply that carbon taxes reduce short-run and cumulative emissions less than predicted by standard models. The slow dynamics also imply that higher carbon taxes and greater reductions in output are needed to achieve a given environmental target.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究气候变化减缓政策在减少碳排放方面的有效性，重点关注经济整体能源效率这一渠道。利用美国数据，我们估计了一个脉冲响应函数（IRF），刻画能源效率如何对能源价格冲击作出反应。标准气候-经济模型无法复制数据中观察到的缓慢转型动态。我们构建了一个可处理的模型，该模型嵌套了现有文献，并能够紧密复制实证IRF。我们模型中的缓慢动态意味着，碳税减少短期和累积排放的程度低于标准模型的预测。缓慢动态还意味着，要实现给定的环境目标，需要更高的碳税和更大的产出削减。

articles.title_en: The Potential of Carbon Border Adjustments to Foster Climate Cooperation
articles.title_cn: 碳边境调整促进气候合作的潜力
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the potential of the European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (EU CBAM) to foster a climate coalition. Using a general equilibrium quantitative trade model to evaluate the payoffs of a coalition formation game, we find that the EU CBAM motivates the adoption of carbon pricing in four countries. This results in a 73% greater reduction in global emissions compared to a scenario in which only the EU prices carbon, with the coalition-building effect outweighing the direct anti-leakage effect of the CBAM. This effect holds across a broad range of policy designs and modeling assumptions. The size of the induced climate coalition varies strongly with trade elasticities and marginally with input substitutability. Next to the carbon price level, the CBAM implementation plays a decisive role: a CBAM that covers more products or indirect emissions leads to larger coalitions. By contrast, introducing export rebates renders the coalition unattractive.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了欧盟碳边境调整机制（EU CBAM）促进气候联盟的潜力。使用一般均衡定量贸易模型来评估联盟形成博弈的收益，我们发现EU CBAM激励了四个国家采用碳定价。与只有欧盟对碳定价的情景相比，这使得全球排放量额外减少了73%，联盟构建效应超过了CBAM的直接反泄漏效应。这一效应在广泛的政策设计和建模假设下均成立。所诱导的气候联盟规模随贸易弹性强烈变化，并随投入品可替代性边际变化。除碳价格水平外，CBAM的实施也起着决定性作用：覆盖更多产品或间接排放的CBAM会导致更大的联盟。相比之下，引入出口退税使联盟变得缺乏吸引力。

articles.title_en: Electricity, Agricultural Productivity, and Deforestation: Evidence from Brazil
articles.title_cn: 电力、农业生产率与森林砍伐：来自巴西的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of improved access to electricity on deforestation through the incentives it creates for farms to switch from cattle grazing to croplands. We generate a model that elucidates the conditions under which increases in agricultural productivity can increase the incentives to intensify rather than expand land use and examine the predictions of that model using county-level data from five waves of the Brazilian Census of Agriculture and satellite-based measures of land use. We estimate the impact of rural electrification in Brazil from 1960 to 2000 and the resulting increases in agricultural productivity. We show that locations suitable for hydropower generation experienced improvements in crop yields incentivizing credit-constrained farmers to shift away from land-intensive cattle grazing and into cropping. As a result, agricultural land use declined, more native vegetation was protected, and these effects persist 25 years later in both census and satellite data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察改善电力可及性通过为农场从放牧转向耕地所创造的激励对森林砍伐的影响。我们构建了一个模型，阐明农业生产率提高在何种条件下会增加集约化而非扩张土地利用的激励，并使用来自五轮巴西农业普查的县级数据和基于卫星的土地利用测量来检验该模型的预测。我们估计了巴西农村电气化从1960到2000的影响以及由此带来的农业生产率提高。我们表明，适合水力发电的地点经历了作物产量的改善，激励受信贷约束的农民从土地密集型的放牧转向种植。结果，农业土地利用下降，更多原生植被得到保护，且这些效应在25年后仍在普查和卫星数据中持续存在。

articles.title_en: Mismeasured and Misunderstood: Unmasking the Temperature Proxy Problem in Climate Impact Estimates
articles.title_cn: 测量错误与理解偏差：揭示气候影响估计中的温度代理变量问题
articles.abstract_en: Thousands of studies estimate climate change impacts related to temperature, but temperature is rarely measured at the exact location where impacts occur. Empirical work uses proxies such as closest station readings or estimates from gridded data products like PRISM. Measurement error introduced from this practice is routinely ignored. When acknowledged, it is typically assumed small in magnitude and classically (i.i.d. normal) distributed, implying that impact estimates are modestly attenuated toward zero. This assumption is formally examined by treating temperature readings at US weather stations as ground truth, then predicting daily mean temperature there using various proxies. This allows precise identification of measurement errors in an otherwise error-free relationship. The results contradict the standard assumption. These errors exhibit strong spatial and temporal components and, often, are large in magnitude. While proxy measurement errors typically cause downward bias, overestimates are common. Estimation problems are concentrated where attention focuses—the temperature distribution’s tails.
articles.abstract_cn: 数千项研究估计与温度相关的气候变化影响，但温度很少在影响发生的精确位置被测量。实证研究使用诸如最近气象站读数或来自PRISM等网格化数据产品的估计值等代理变量。这种做法引入的测量误差通常被忽略。当被承认时，通常假定其幅度较小且为经典（i.i.d. 正态）分布，意味着影响估计会适度向零衰减。本文通过将美国气象站的温度读数视为地面真值，然后使用各种代理变量预测那里的日平均温度，对这一假设进行了正式检验。这使得能够在原本无误差的关系中精确识别测量误差。结果与标准假设相矛盾。这些误差表现出强烈的空间和时间成分，并且通常幅度很大。虽然代理测量误差通常导致向下偏误，但高估也很常见。估计问题集中在注意力聚焦之处——温度分布的尾部。
